answer: Your ex has to sign the sale documents like any co-owner, unless your divorce decree awards the car to you; in that case, bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature isn't needed. For the name mismatch, bring the document that shows the change (such as your divorce decree or a court order), and you'll sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment. If your ex does need to sign but can't come to the appointment, they can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2 electronically with no notary, except in Georgia, where it must be notarized. All owners who attend should bring their photo IDs.
